How do we go from the first

sT.headline:
A dedicated team builds
and runs our systems.
sT.body: Plenty of contractors still run a job on paper. WS has its own team that builds and runs every system in this film.

s1.kicker: From the first enquiry to the handover
s1.headline: Every job travels the same road.
s1.clientLine: What the client sees: the scope agreed, the programme, the work verified on site and every claim backed by the record.

s2.headline:
We measure the way
we build it.
s2.body: Every quantity is taken off in CostX, elevation by elevation, the way the crew will build it, so nothing is guessed.
s2.chip: For the builder: a clear scope and a sharper price

screen.title: CostX · WS0194 · facade package
screen.note: Measured off the drawings, elevation by elevation.

s3.headline:
Scope and price
agreed in one place.
chips: Priced by engineers and architects who specialise in facades
Two peer reviews before anything leaves the office
Every revision tracked in the platform
Two-party e-signature with a tamper-evident audit trail
For the builder: the agreed scope and price behind one link
s3.title: Facade package · WS0194

sC.headline:
Legal review before
the contract is signed.
sC.benefit: For the builder: the terms are settled before the first day on site
roles: Oversees the job, invoices and talks to the client

sO.headline:
WS has a dedicated system to run project
management and site execution.
steps: The programme is set in the office
The worker gets everything in the app
The day's job lands on the phone
The site fence is already in the app
sO.benefit: For the worker: the whole day is in the app before the shift starts

s4.label: Documents, approvals and site records sit under it. The same number follows the job from the schedule to the invoice.
s4.complianceChip: SWMS, ITPs, insurances and licences filed against the job
s4.headline: Every job gets its own number.
s4.benefit: For the builder: the job's compliance records in one place

s5.headline: The executive team plans the week. The system carries it.
s5.body: Every task on the programme lands on each worker's phone as “My day”. What happens on site comes back the same way, so progress, ITPs and claims rest on the record instead of memory.
s5.chip: For the worker: the app shows where to be each day
s5.chip2: For the builder: every claim traced back to the hours behind it

s6.headline:
Verified at
the site fence.
s6.body: The phone confirms the worker is inside the site fence and starts the shift. Every hour is geo-referenced and validated, so the record depends less on people and avoids errors and disputes with the client.
chips: For the worker: the shift starts by itself, phone in the pocket
For the builder: fewer errors in the hours behind each claim
For the end client: hours that can be checked against the site

s7.headline: One app for every worker.
features: a web app plus a native shell, and it updates itself on every deploy
Portuguese first, English always one tap away
arrive on site and the shift starts itself
Site records, captured on the spot
site diary, materials, equipment and incidents, filed against the job as they happen

clock.title: GeoClock
clock.sub: On site · WS0194 · 14 m inside the fence
clock.auto: Auto mode: clock-in on arrival and clock-out on leaving, even with the app closed.

ts.title: Timesheet
ts.sub: This week · from the clock, nothing typed

s7.benefit: For the worker: everything for the day on one phone

s8.headline: Everyone on site, inducted and verified.
s8.body: Every builder runs a different induction system. The platform carries that difference, so every WS worker still meets one standard.
chips: For the builder: nobody on site works unverified
Inductions and task-specific training in one place
Toolbox meetings filed against the job, not on loose paper
WS Academy: bilingual modules, quiz pass mark 100%
s8.pdfNote: Induction agreement counter-signed and filed as a PDF

s9.headline: The clock is the source of truth.
chips: For the worker: paid on the hours the clock recorded

sbox.headline:
One suite
for the site.
sbox.body: One suite carries the crew’s day, from the clock-in at the site fence to a payroll-ready timesheet.
